detailed_description: The Batch Timestamp Converter converts multiple pasted timestamp values in one browser-side workflow. Paste one timestamp per line, choose a timezone, select either local format or ISO 8601 output, and click Convert to review a table with the original value, detected format, and converted result. The current interface detects seconds, milliseconds, and ISO-style timestamps, marks invalid rows, and lets you copy all converted results or download the table as CSV or JSON.
usage_steps: Paste one timestamp per line into the input area.
Choose the timezone and select local format or ISO 8601 as the output format.
Click Convert to build the results table with detected formats and converted values.
Copy all results, export the table as CSV or JSON, or clear the input to start again.
usage_examples: Convert a pasted list of Unix seconds from logs into readable local-time values.
Check whether mixed timestamp rows are detected as seconds, milliseconds, ISO 8601, or invalid.
Export a small timestamp conversion table as CSV or JSON for a debugging note.
